subject: Ignite Summit demo — pilot proposal & timing?
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Chang <daniel.chang@opticware.com>, Sarah Ling <sarah.ling@opticware.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 15:32:00 -0800
Subject: Ignite Summit — quick demo recap & next steps

Hi Daniel / Sarah —

Great meeting you both at the Ignite Summit booth yesterday — thanks for the demo time on Friday. Quick recap from our side so we're aligned before we dig into logistics: 

- What we showed: Redwood Dedicated + private VPC option, prefix/KV caching to keep cold-start latency down, and our batching profile that trades a few ms for big cost savings on bursty workloads.
- What you mentioned as top priorities: predictable p99 latency, predictable monthly cost for inference, and the ability to run in a customer VPC for compliance.
- Rough scale note you gave: ~250–500 QPS baseline with occasional spikes to ~1k QPS (30–45s peak windows).

Next steps I proposed at the booth:
1) Put together a short pilot outline and proposed SOW (attached).
2) Quick technical sync with your infra/MLOps team to validate networking and latency expectations (30–45 minutes).
3) If that looks good, run a two-week pilot on Dedicated capacity with a simplified workload to validate p99 and cost.

I've attached a one-page pilot-outline and a short SLA summary (pilot-outline.pdf, redwood-sla-summary.pdf). Can you share who from OpticWare would join the technical sync and a couple slots for next week? 

I'm happy to include Sergio on the thread (he owns pilots + deployment at Redwood). Looking forward —

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference runtime

Attachments: pilot-outline.pdf (1 page), redwood-sla-summary.pdf (2 pages)
From: Daniel Chang <daniel.chang@opticware.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ignite Summit — quick demo recap & next steps

Marissa — thanks for the follow-up and the materials. Appreciate the concise outline.

We are definitely interested — primary concerns are p99 latency (we target <120ms) and a deterministic monthly spend for forecasting. The VPC option is a must.

For the tech sync, our infra lead (Sarah Ling) and one of our ML engineers (I'll loop in Joel after this reply) should attend. Proposed times: Tue 11/17 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 11/18 14:00–14:45 PT. Either works for us.

Also could you include a very rough ballpark for a 2-week pilot on Dedicated (baseline 300 QPS, peaks to 1k)? Even a 2–3 line estimate will help unblock procurement on our side before the call.

Thanks —
Daniel
Daniel Chang | Director of Engineering, OpticWare
daniel.chang@opticware.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Chang <daniel.chang@opticware.com>, Sarah Ling <sarah.ling@opticware.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 12:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ignite Summit — quick demo recap & next steps

Thanks Daniel — great, appreciate the quick reply.

I'm confirming Wed 11/18 14:00–14:30 PT for a focused tech sync (I've booked 30m and will send a calendar invite). Agenda: 
- 5m quick intros & goals
- 10m infra/networking (VPC, NAT, firewall rules)
- 10m performance expectation (p99, perf testing plan)
- 5m next steps / pilot logistics

Attached is a short proposed SOW for the two-week pilot and a very rough pilot cost band for planning (proposed-sow.docx). Ballpark for a 2-week Dedicated pilot (300 QPS baseline, short spikes to ~1k): $18k–$28k depending on GPU tier and whether you opt for burst capacity. We'll firm that up after the tech sync and exact traffic profile.

If you can confirm attendees (Sarah + Joel would be perfect), I'll loop in our deployment engineer for the call too. If compliance docs are required ahead of the pilot, let me know and I'll pull the right artifacts.

On Wed I will share a short checklist for networking access to make setup fast.

See you Wednesday —

Subject: Checking in — Ignite pilot timing

Hi Daniel / Sarah —

Just circling back on this thread — wanted to check whether the pilot is still a priority for OpticWare and whether the timing has shifted since Ignite. If you still want to proceed, we can start the two-week pilot as early as Dec 1 (subject to finalizing the SOW and a short tech sync).

If your priorities have changed or you'd like a lighter-weight eval first (single-model perf run instead of a full Dedicated pilot), happy to propose that as an alternative. Quick yes/no here would help us make the right resource commitments.
